assertionResults.reason: The current contract removes the prior trend-arrow requirement, and the analytics screen now satisfies the remaining requirement: a horizontal row of bordered warm stat cards with 12px radius and 22px/700 values.

references.details: The current contract defines VAL-ANALYTICS-002 as horizontal stat cards with card background, 1px border, 12px radius, and 22px/700 values, and explicitly notes that trend arrows were removed because the analytics data model does not provide trend data.
The summary row is a horizontal ScrollView of stat cards. Each card uses colors.surface[100], borderWidth: 1, colors.surface[300], borderRadius: 12, and a 22px / 700 value text style.
Theme tokens resolve the warm card and border colors used by the stat cards to #F7F3ED and #D9D0C4.

assertionResults.reason: The current contract replaces the old segmented toggle with a filtered pending-task view plus a collapsible completed section, and the tasks screen implements that structure.

references.details: The updated contract says the segmented toggle was replaced by section-based task organization and passes if pending tasks are displayed with a collapsible completed section.
TasksScreen derives pendingTasks and completedTasks, then groups pending work into dueTodayTasks, thisWeekTasks, and upcomingTasks for the filtered pending view.
Pending tasks render under Due Today, This Week, and Upcoming section headers.
Completed tasks live in a separate collapsible section with a chevron toggle, count badge, and conditional expanded rendering.

assertionResults.reason: The spray catalog cards are border-only and include the required 3px spray-green strip plus the chemical name, but the info line still renders PHI, dose, and target problem instead of the contract-required active ingredient / concentration metadata.

references.details: The current contract requires chemical cards with a 3px spray-green left strip, chemical name, and an info line showing active ingredient / concentration, while noting only the type badge and PHI warning requirements were removed.
Each card uses a 1px border and 3px spray strip, renders mix.name, and the visible info row is PHI, Dose, and target_problem rather than active ingredient / concentration.
active_ingredient is referenced for search matching only, not rendered on the card body.
The catalog mapping preserves active_ingredient and dose data on each ChemicalMixComponent, so the missing active-ingredient display is a presentation gap in the card renderer.

summary: Retested 3 reassigned assertions by read-only code review against the current contract: VAL-ANALYTICS-002 passed, VAL-TASKS-002 passed, and VAL-SPRAY-001 failed because the card info line still does not show active ingredient / concentration metadata.
